en: Colorized vintage street view showing the Rathaus (town hall) area of Freiberg in Saxony. On the left is a large masonry building with the word "SPARKASSE" on the wall, and people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or cycle along the street. In the distance stands a multi‑storey corner house with red roofs and shop signs at street level. The sky is bright blue with light clouds, typical of tinted postcards.
